name: venture-falsification-and-planning
intent: Transform a venture idea into an evidence ledger, kill criteria, staged experiments, resource bounds, and explicit decision points.
successCondition: Stop when every existential assumption has evidence status, a bounded test or an explicit accepted uncertainty and decision owner.
inputs: supplied customer market and operational evidence
outputs: stage plan experiments kill criteria and decision gates
operations: rank existential assumptions by cost and reversibility
define decision thresholds resource caps and next-state plans
preconditions: the stage and resource ceiling are explicit
positiveTriggers: Stress-test a venture thesis before committing resources.
Create a stage-aware plan with assumptions experiments and kill criteria.
negativeTriggers: Commit funds or make regulated investment recommendations.
Treat forecasts or enthusiasm as validated demand.
failureModes: stop when a decision depends on unavailable current evidence
surface irreducible uncertainty instead of manufacturing confidence
exclusions: does not provide legal tax or investment advice
does not contact customers or commit resources
terminationConditions: Stop when every existential assumption has evidence status, a bounded test or an explicit accepted uncertainty and decision owner.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-prometheus route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
